messages.content:
DB2 is IBM's relational database management system for z/OS mainframes. Key features:

1. SQL Support - Standard SQL for data manipulation
2. High Availability - Data sharing, disaster recovery
3. Performance - Optimized for high-volume transactions
4. Security - Row/column level security, encryption
5. Integration - Works with COBOL, CICS, IMS

DB2 stores data in tablespaces and uses packages/plans for SQL access.
Write COBOL with embedded SQL SELECT

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2SEL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMP-ID           PIC X(6).
       01 WS-EMP-NAME         PIC X(30).
       01 WS-SALARY           PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE '000010' TO WS-EMP-ID
           EXEC SQL
               SELECT FIRSTNME, SALARY
               INTO :WS-EMP-NAME, :WS-SALARY
               FROM EMPLOYEE
               WHERE EMPNO = :WS-EMP-ID
           END-EXEC
           IF SQLCODE = 0
               DISPLAY 'NAME: ' WS-EMP-NAME
               DISPLAY 'SALARY: ' WS-SALARY
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' SQLCODE
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2CURS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMP-ID           PIC X(6).
       01 WS-EMP-NAME         PIC X(30).
       01 WS-EOF              PIC 9 VALUE 0.
           EXEC SQL
               DECLARE EMP_CURSOR CURSOR FOR
               SELECT EMPNO, FIRSTNME
               FROM EMPLOYEE
               WHERE WORKDEPT = 'D11'
               ORDER BY EMPNO
           END-EXEC.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC SQL OPEN EMP_CURSOR END-EXEC
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 1
               EXEC SQL
                   FETCH EMP_CURSOR
                   INTO :WS-EMP-ID, :WS-EMP-NAME
               END-EXEC
               IF SQLCODE = 100
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
               ELSE
                   DISPLAY WS-EMP-ID ' ' WS-EMP-NAME
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           EXEC SQL CLOSE EMP_CURSOR END-EXEC
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2INS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMP-ID           PIC X(6).
       01 WS-EMP-NAME         PIC X(30).
       01 WS-DEPT             PIC X(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE '999999' TO WS-EMP-ID
           MOVE 'NEW EMPLOYEE' TO WS-EMP-NAME
           MOVE 'D11' TO WS-DEPT
           EXEC SQL
               INSERT INTO EMPLOYEE
               (EMPNO, FIRSTNME, WORKDEPT)
               VALUES
               (:WS-EMP-ID, :WS-EMP-NAME, :WS-DEPT)
           END-EXEC
           IF SQLCODE = 0
               DISPLAY 'INSERT SUCCESSFUL'
               EXEC SQL COMMIT END-EXEC
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'INSERT FAILED: ' SQLCODE
               EXEC SQL ROLLBACK END-EXEC
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2UPD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMP-ID           PIC X(6).
       01 WS-NEW-SALARY       PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE '000010' TO WS-EMP-ID
           MOVE 75000.00 TO WS-NEW-SALARY
           EXEC SQL
               UPDATE EMPLOYEE
               SET SALARY = :WS-NEW-SALARY
               WHERE EMPNO = :WS-EMP-ID
           END-EXEC
           IF SQLCODE = 0
               DISPLAY 'UPDATE SUCCESSFUL'
               EXEC SQL COMMIT END-EXEC
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'UPDATE FAILED: ' SQLCODE
               EXEC SQL ROLLBACK END-EXEC
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2DEL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMP-ID           PIC X(6).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE '999999' TO WS-EMP-ID
           EXEC SQL
               DELETE FROM EMPLOYEE
               WHERE EMPNO = :WS-EMP-ID
           END-EXEC
           IF SQLCODE = 0
               DISPLAY 'DELETE SUCCESSFUL'
               EXEC SQL COMMIT END-EXEC
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'DELETE FAILED: ' SQLCODE
               EXEC SQL ROLLBACK END-EXEC
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

CREATE TABLE SCHEMA.CUSTOMER (
    CUST_ID      CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    CUST_NAME    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    ADDRESS      VARCHAR(100),
    CITY         VARCHAR(30),
    STATE        CHAR(2),
    ZIP          CHAR(10),
    PHONE        VARCHAR(15),
    EMAIL        VARCHAR(50),
    CREATE_DATE  DATE DEFAULT CURRENT DATE,
    UPDATE_TS    TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (CUST_ID)
) IN DATABASE.TABLESPACE;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX SCHEMA.CUST_IDX1
    ON SCHEMA.CUSTOMER (CUST_ID ASC)
    USING STOGROUP SYSDEFLT
    PRIQTY 100
    SECQTY 50
    BUFFERPOOL BP0;

CREATE INDEX SCHEMA.CUST_IDX2
    ON SCHEMA.CUSTOMER (CUST_NAME ASC, CITY ASC);
Write COBOL with DB2 WHENEVER for error handling

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2ERR.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-DATA             PIC X(100).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC SQL
               WHENEVER SQLERROR GOTO ERROR-PARA
           END-EXEC
           EXEC SQL
               WHENEVER NOT FOUND GOTO NOTFOUND-PARA
           END-EXEC
           PERFORM MAIN-PROCESS
           STOP RUN.
       MAIN-PROCESS.
           EXEC SQL
               SELECT * INTO :WS-DATA
               FROM MYTABLE
               WHERE KEY = '001'
           END-EXEC.
       NOTFOUND-PARA.
           DISPLAY 'RECORD NOT FOUND'
           STOP RUN.
       ERROR-PARA.
           DISPLAY 'SQL ERROR: ' SQLCODE
           DISPLAY 'SQLSTATE: ' SQLSTATE
           EXEC SQL ROLLBACK END-EXEC
           STOP RUN.
